text:
Maya (partnerships): Hey team :wave: Azure Marketplace just sent a security checklist. They want a signed SOC2 cover letter, a pen-test statement (or schedule), and an evidence bundle (S3 presigned links). Deadline: EOD Friday from their PM. Can we confirm owners and whether we can provide presigned links?

Kevin (security): I can take SOC2 cover letter + inventory of recent scans. Need Legal to sign the cover letter. @Anna (legal) can you confirm signatory and any required language?

Anna (legal): I can sign a one-page attestation. Please draft with bullets of what we are attesting to (scope, timeframe, exclusions). No need to invent controls.

Olivia (partner-eng): For the evidence bundle I'll prepare an artifact index and scrub any customer data. Plan: upload artifacts to a hardened bucket `redwood-marketplace-evidence` and share presigned links with 7d expiry. We'll redact hostnames/IPs.

Sam (cloudops): For presigned links here's the quick command I plan to use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/<file> --expires-in 604800` (7 days). I'll also apply a lifecycle rule to delete objects after 14 days. Who needs upload IAM access?

Maya (partnerships): Owners proposed: Kevin = SOC2 + scan inventory, Olivia = artifact prep + redaction, Sam = bucket + presigned links, Anna = signature. Sound good? :thumbsup: 

Kevin (security): One caveat — we don't have an external third-party pen-test this quarter. Marketplace will accept an internal vuln-scan report if we provide a booked external test with vendor/ETA. I can attach our internal scan (Nessus/Trivy outputs) and a proposed schedule for an external pentest.

Anna (legal): Marketplace usually wants a contracted vendor and PO for the external test if we're promising it. If you include the vendor name and date window in the attestation that's usually sufficient.

Olivia (partner-eng): I'll start cleaning up artifacts (scans, config snapshots, SOC2 excerpts). Question: do we need to remove internal IP ranges or just redact hostnames? Marketplace text: "sensitive infra details may be redacted" — we'll strip full hostnames, IPs, and AWS account IDs.

Sam (cloudops): Approved to create `redwood-marketplace-evidence` bucket. I'll follow infra hardening checklist and restrict upload to a temporary role. Tag uploads with `marketplace-evidence:true`. I'll post the presign links once uploaded.

Maya (partnerships): Please also include an artifacts index file (CSV or JSON) that lists filename, owner, redaction notes. Olivia can own that.

Olivia (partner-eng): On it. I'll include a short README with redaction decisions and a contact email for follow-ups.

Kevin (security): I'll draft the SOC2 cover letter + scan summary this afternoon and drop a Google Doc link here. Anna — will you review/approve signature once I mark it ready?

Anna (legal): Yes. Share the doc and I'll review. If language is standard, I can sign same day.

ci-bot: artefact-upload-checklist: checklist created -> https://internal.redwood.dev/marketplace-evidence/checklist (auto note) :eyes: 

Maya (partnerships): Great — timeline recap: draft attestation + scan inventory by EOD today, artifact upload + presigns by tomorrow noon, legal sign-off once doc is ready, reply to marketplace PM by Friday COB with links and schedule for external pentest. If anything slips, flag here.

Sam (cloudops): I'll request the temporary IAM role now and ping when ready.

Olivia (partner-eng): I'll post initial artifact index in ~3 hours.

Kevin (security): Draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-example (will update).

Maya (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Please react here when you complete your item so I can track. :lock:
